WTO | resources gateway | WTO bookshop WORLD TRADE ORGANIZATION Home | About WTO | News & events | Trade topics | WTO membership | Documents & resources | External relations Contact us | Site map | A-Z | Search español français home resources wto bookshop WTO bookshop The WTO Bookshop offers more than 1,000 titles covering all aspects of world trade. The most recent WTO publications can be found alongside titles from over 50 publishers. The bookshop also offers exclusive gifts and souvenirs bearing the WTO logo. The souvenir catalogue is available here . WTO
          Bookshop Centre William Rappard 154 rue de Lausanne Geneva, Switzerland tel: +41 (22) 739 51 05 fax: +41 (22) 739 57 92 [email protected] Opening hours: Monday — Friday 9h00 — 12h30 14h00 — 17h00 Visitor access: A valid passport or ID card is required
          to enter WTO premises. Full list of bookshop  titles Download the latest  list of titles to see what is available right now — from bestsellers to new  arrivals. Opening hours The bookshop is open from Monday to Friday from 9h00 to  12h30 and in the afternoons from 14h00 to 17h00. A valid passport or ID card is  required to enter WTO premises. You can also consult the WTO online bookshop or browse  through our non-WTO titles catalogue and place an order in three simple steps: Send an email (containing your selections and contact details) to [email protected] . You will be contacted within 24-48 hours to arrange payment. Credit card  payment can be arranged immediately over the phone. You may receive your books in three ways: Free of charge pick-up from the bookshop Free of charge shipment within Switzerland Shipment outside of Switzerland, with a 15% shipment charge added to your bill. WTO Online Bookshop If you wish to  purchase WTO publications, these can be ordered directly from the WTO Online  Bookshop . Share Newsletter Previous issues Subscribe Problems viewing this page?
